plugins.name: rocky
plugins.description: Personal agent toolkit. Run many agent sessions from one machine: hand work out (board, handoffs, spawn), bring results back to merge (PR watch, default-branch verify, review-fix), watch and steer from anywhere (web UI, remote control, statusline), and record it all (worklog, token and usage logs). Rust daemon + CLI with a thin Claude Code plugin.
